digest.component_or_area: completion workflow error recovery and diagnostics
propositions: Step-budget exhaustion diagnostic (tool call repetition counters and loop detection metrics) is computed in interpret_failure but dropped before reaching the operator message because it is not propagated through the recovery and failure paths.

The gate_error_v1 sidecar is not emitted on budget exhaustion because failure_diagnostic is only set in CompletionAgentStep._recover, which budget exhaustion never reaches without the recovery entry edge fix.

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist currently strips repetition keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and rejects list-typed values, preventing the computed diagnostic from surviving the exception merge.
Operators cannot distinguish between looping (high repetition) and actual budget exhaustion (room out) from the CLI message alone, forcing manual log inspection or incorrect budget escalation.

The fix must widen _bounded_diagnostic to pass repetition keys and list-valued top_repeated_tool_calls through merge, prefix them with aggregate_ on the primary-exception path, then render them via format_repetition in the close-gate message.
